description: Movement-direction cases defining how the optional vehicles.schema.json bearing is derived from movement; shared by services/backend/internal/service/vehicles/direction_test.go and apps/web/tests/vehicle-direction.test.mjs, so the Go and browser trackers stay identical. Each check is [milliseconds since start, [[route, longitude, latitude], ...]]; want is the bearing per vehicle after the last check, null without one. 0.001 degrees of latitude is about 111 m; of longitude about 82 m at Podgorica.

cases.name: standing still keeps the last direction
small steps add up from the movement anchor
matched by route and nearest position, not order
an implausible jump is a different vehicle
a check from the past forgets history
